title: Motion Beyond Pixels: Learning Future Visual Representations for Object-Centric Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.34644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. translated_title: 超越像素的运动：面向以物体为中心的动力学学习未来视觉表征
translated_abstract: 许多具身世界模型在为RGB重建优化的潜在空间中预测未来状态，而这些空间并未显式地优先考虑与运动生成相关的物体级语义和几何信息。我们提出了MotionRep，这是一种视觉表征世界模型，能够联合生成未来的DINO表征和3D物体流，将语义与几何信息同以物体为中心的动力学相耦合。为了使高维DINO特征适用于生成建模，我们引入了DINO-VAE，它将时间与通道压缩和潜在正则化相结合，在保留语义和几何信息的同时产生紧凑的潜在表示。在初始观测、物体查询点和语言指令的条件下，一个统一的扩散Transformer通过联合注意力机制预测未来的视觉表征和3D物体流。MotionRep采用针对不同模态的非对称噪声调度，以保持视觉流……
tldr: 本文提出MotionRep视觉表征世界模型，通过DINO-VAE压缩高维特征并利用统一扩散Transformer联合生成未来DINO表征与3D物体流，将语义几何信息与以物体为中心的动力学耦合，从而超越传统的RGB像素级运动预测。
en_tdlr: MotionRep is a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow using DINO-VAE and a unified diffusion transformer, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics beyond RGB pixels.
